Question 10
?

Let B={b1,b2,b3} be a basis of R3 and [x]B=[4−52]. What are the coordinates of x relative to the basis C={c1,c2,c3}, where c1=−2b2, c2=b3 and c3=−3b1?

a
[x]C=[52−3]
b
[x]C=[522−43]
c
[x]C=[252−34]
d
[x]C=[52−43]
e
[x]C=[522−4]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Since [x]B=[4−52], we can write x as follows:

x=4b1−5b2+2b3=−5b2+2b3+4b1=5(−b2)+2b3−4(−b1)=52(−2b2)+2c2−43(−3b1)=52c1+2c2−43c3

Therefore, [x]C=[522−43].
